title: Allergen Information
description: What the Business states about a dish's allergens, per allergen code. A code not listed is not recorded: it MUST NOT be read as absent.

code_list.description: The list the allergen codes come from, so codes do not depend on string matching across jurisdictions.

status.description: 'contains': an ingredient. 'may_contain': cross-contact is possible (e.g., shared equipment). 'free_of': the Business states the dish is free of it; a Platform MUST NOT infer this status.

source.description: Who states it: `business`, or a declaration the Business relies on (e.g., `supplier_declaration`).

items.description: One entry per allergen the Business states something about.
